items.briefing:
Australian and New Zealand organisations are being warned of a surge in critical security vulnerabilities, coinciding with a global spike in cyberattacks and ransomware activity reported through July. A serious flaw in VMware vCenter is actively being exploited in a widespread threat campaign, meaning any organisation running this software should prioritise patching immediately. AI-powered cybercrime is also increasing in scale, making attacks faster and harder to detect.

To stay protected, ensure all software — especially server and virtualisation tools — is kept up to date with the latest security patches.

featured.title: Australia & New Zealand face surge in critical flaws
featured.quote: Critical patch backlogs expose Australian organisations to immediate, widespread security threats.
